{
  "project_id": "P-NGA-AgroProcessingLivelihood",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Macroeconomic recession and fiscal pressure could reduce government capacity to fund staff and operational costs at Federal and State levels.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Secure a detailed budget commitment from Ministry of Finance; establish contingency financing with IDA; monitor fiscal indicators quarterly and adjust implementation scope as needed.",
      "evidence": "Oil price shock caused recession; “no counterpart funding is required… however, the Federal Government and the participating states will ensure adequate funding of staff and operating cost…\""
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Procurement capacity remains low in many states, risking delays, non‑compliance, or cost overruns for goods and works.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy the procurement consultant to train procurement officers; use standard bidding documents; implement a phased procurement plan with regular performance reviews.",
      "evidence": "Procurement capacity is still considered low and most of the states do not have procurement tools…"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "State Coordination Offices (SCOs) in new states (e.g., Kogi) may not be fully staffed or operational on schedule, slowing project rollout.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize recruitment and onboarding of SCO staff; set up a transition task force; monitor milestones with a 2‑week reporting cadence.",
      "evidence": "New SCOs will be created in Kogi state and in additional participating states… the staff composition is expected to differ…"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Low adoption of improved climate‑smart technologies by beneficiaries could limit productivity gains.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Tie grant disbursement to demonstrated technology use; strengthen extension services; conduct farmer field days and peer‑learning events.",
      "evidence": "Historically limited adoption of existing improved technologies by producers… matching grant mechanism will be used as an incentive to stimulate farmer’s participation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Inadequate documentation of travel advances and other soft expenditures may lead to unaudited claims and financial losses.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement the enhanced accountability framework detailed in the Financial Procedures Manual; require electronic receipts and periodic internal audit of travel expenses.",
      "evidence": "Key issues noted… unretired advances and inadequate documentation of eligible expenditures incurred… an enhanced accountability framework will be implemented."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Use of fertilizers and pesticides could contaminate soil and water, triggering environmental non‑compliance.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce the Integrated Pest Management Plan; provide training on safe handling; conduct regular water‑soil monitoring around pilot sites.",
      "evidence": "Possible adverse impacts… use of agricultural chemical inputs (fertilizers, pesticides…) could include contamination of soils and surface water."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Infrastructure works (roads, jetties, small dams) may require land acquisition, leading to involuntary resettlement disputes.",
      "category": "social",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prepare Resettlement Action Plans in line with the RPF before any works; ensure transparent compensation and grievance mechanisms.",
      "evidence": "Involuntary resettlement (OP/BP 4.12) is activated… the RPF outlines the resettlement process…"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Business alliances may fail to attract reliable off‑takers, reducing market access for farmer groups.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct early market linkage assessments; secure off‑taker commitments through memoranda of understanding; monitor alliance performance quarterly.",
      "evidence": "Business alliances will be established… to facilitate linkages between farmer/producer organizations… and off‑takers (buyers) and processors."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Projected benefits are sensitive to a 20% drop in commodity prices, which would turn NPV negative.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Introduce price‑risk hedging tools for beneficiaries; diversify value‑chain focus; periodically reassess market forecasts and adjust grant sizes.",
      "evidence": "If benefits were reduced by 20 percent for all the crops, the net present values will turn negative… the project is sensitive to a reduction in output prices."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Gender targets may not be met if women face cultural or credit constraints, limiting project’s poverty‑reduction impact.",
      "category": "social",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set gender‑specific disbursement milestones; partner with women’s NGOs for outreach; monitor gender participation through the gender tracker.",
      "evidence": "The project will specifically target women and youth… 35 percent of the project beneficiaries are expected to be women."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Delays in signing and ratifying Subsidiary Agreements with participating states could stall credit withdrawals.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish a legal task force to fast‑track subsidiary agreement execution; set a 30‑day review window; tie withdrawal schedules to agreement receipt.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawal shall be made … unless the Subsidiary Agreement has been duly authorized or ratified…"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Political instability or security incidents in the North‑East and Niger Delta could impede field activities and beneficiary access.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop security protocols with local authorities; allocate flexible implementation windows; maintain a contingency fund for security‑related disruptions.",
      "evidence": "The government seeks to improve security in the North East and Niger Delta… security challenges are highlighted."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Inadequate monitoring data due to limited M&E capacity at SCO level may compromise performance tracking.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy a central M&E support team; conduct bi‑annual training for SCO M&E officers; use the MIS for automated data validation.",
      "evidence": "M&E specialists will be staffed… data collection will be coordinated… the M&E system will include a gender tracker."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Procurement fraud, collusion, or coercion could arise given the large volume of grant and contract awards.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply the anti‑corruption guidelines; enforce competitive bidding thresholds; mandate public de‑briefings for all contracts above $300,000; conduct random audits.",
      "evidence": "All procuring entities … must observe the highest standard of ethics… Guidelines on Preventing and Combating Fraud and Corruption…"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Climate‑related shocks (floods, drought) could reduce yield improvements despite climate‑smart practices.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Promote resilient crop varieties; integrate water‑management infrastructure; incorporate climate risk buffers in the value‑chain investment plans.",
      "evidence": "Project aims to enhance productivity through climate‑smart practices… sensitivity analysis shows robustness to input cost increases but not to output shocks."
    }
  ]
}
